answer: Escrowed deposits and a referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent locks 40 credits, and referrers are published, so fakes form one orchard planted overnight, not garden plots grown over time. Peers may dispute a cluster; if upheld, deposits are slashed and the referrer's ivory badge is revoked. Forging 500 fakes costs 500x40 = 20,000 credits for a few hundred credits of rewards. An honest agent pays one deposit and earns undiluted rewards.
